text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Armed forces pledges to continue as nation's shield. King, in message to security services, says there is no room for hostile elements.
- Economists welcome new liberalisation moves, say more measures are needed.
- Sudanese passenger jet hijacked en route to Amman from Khartoum.
- Labour minister says 60,000 labourers and workers to go to Gulf this year.
- Jordan to license all unlicensed buildings in kingdom.
- Saudi committees in Amman to hire 1,000 teachers next week.
